item.title: 2: Daily Halacha: Wishing a Non-Jew Merry Christmas or Happy New Year
item.description:
Daily Halacha — Avodah Zarah and December Halachic Common Questions Dayan Daniel Kada
Clarification from the previous shiur: it is forbidden to say "Christ" when it is used as an adjective of honour. It is permissible to say Christ's College / Trinity Hall / Christchurch, for the same reasons explained that one is allowed to say Christmas.

item.title: 8: Daily Halacha: Wine Touched by Someone Who Does Not Keep Shabbat
item.description:
May one drink kosher wine that was handled by a Jew who publicly desecrates Shabbat? Some argue he counts like a non-Jew for this law. The Rabbi gives three reasons why that view is not followed and leniency is justified, starting with the reasons behind the prohibition on wine touched by non-Jews.
Daily Halacha — Avodah Zarah and December Halachic Common Questions Dayan Daniel Kada
Part of the Daily Halacha – Avodah Zarah and December Halachic Common Questions series.
